channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Lula diz estar satisfeito com decisões de Fachin sobre crise no STF: 'colocou ordem na casa'
item.description: Lula praised STF President Fachin for restoring order amid the court crisis involving ministers Mendonça and Moraes, centered on the Banco Master investigation and a PF report linking Moraes to banker Daniel Vorcaro.

item.title: 'Faltam 24 dias para a eleição, precisam inventar algo contra mim', diz Flávio Bolsonaro sobre ação da PF envolvendo 'Dark Horse'
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro criticized the Federal Police operation involving the film 'Dark Horse' and alleged embezzlement of parliamentary amendments by Mário Frias, calling it an 'attempted coup' three days before the election. He accused Supreme Court ministers Flávio Dino and Alexandre de Moraes of trying to interfere in the elections and said he will file a lawsuit against Dino at the STF.

item.title: Mario Frias diz não ter ingerência sobre recursos de emendas usadas para financiar Dark Horse
item.description: Mario Frias (PL-RJ) denied having oversight over a parliamentary amendment of 2 million BRL used to fund the film Dark Horse, a biography of Jair Bolsonaro. He was targeted by a Federal Police search and seizure and claims election bias in the investigations, arguing the funds were channeled through NGOs and companies without his direct control.

item.title: Áudio: TSE envia aos TREs programas de registro e apuração de votos das urnas
item.description: The TSE began distributing to the TREs the voting registration and tallying software for the electronic voting machines used in the October 2026 elections. The systems were audited by political parties and civil society and also underwent security testing.

item.title: Saiba quem enviou dinheiro à produtora de “Dark Horse”
item.description: Go Up Entertainment, the production company behind “Dark Horse,” received R$8.93 million from five identified senders between November 10 and December 30, 2025, during filming of the movie about former president Jair Bolsonaro. Brazil’s Federal Police and the CGU are investigating possible irregularities in the use and destination of the funds; Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino lifted the case’s secrecy.

item.title: Frias nega irregularidade e diz que operação da PF é “cortina de fumaça”
item.description: Deputy Mario Frias (PL-SP) denied wrongdoing in a Federal Police operation investigating suspected diversion of parliamentary amendments tied to the film “Dark Horse,” calling it a “smoke screen.” The probe covers 49 search warrants across four states and suggests irregular public-resource use through July 2026. Frias said he will provide requested documents but was not involved in the process or recipient of the transfers.

item.title: La policía investiga si los Bolsonaro usaron dinero público para pagar la película sobre el expresidente
item.description: Brazil's Federal Police are investigating whether public funds financed “Dark Horse,” a biographical film about former President Jair Bolsonaro. The alleged irregularity is Flávio Bolsonaro's biggest campaign risk as he is polling level with Lula in the race for the Oct. 4 election.

item.title: The Economist: Confiança da sociedade brasileira no STF está se desgastando
item.description: Brazil's Supreme Court is losing public trust as Justice Alexandre de Moraes, who oversaw the trial against Jair Bolsonaro, faces corruption allegations tied to the Banco Master Ponzi scheme linked to Daniel Vorcaro. The scandal, involving Moraes's wife being hired as the bank's lawyer, has emerged ahead of the October 2026 general elections.

item.title: Renan Santos envia ao STF pedido de quebra de sigilo do inquérito das fake news e INSS
item.description: Renan Santos, presidential candidate from the Missão party, filed a request with the STF to lift the secrecy of the fake news investigation and the INSS scandal inquiries. The petitions, signed by Kim Kataguiri, emphasize the need for transparency to verify the legality of judicial actions, particularly following the reassignment of the fake news case rapporteur. Santos stresses that Brazilians must understand the behind-the-scenes of corruption, abuses of power, and corporate influences involving political, judicial, and business agents.

item.title: Flávio acusa Dino de autorizar operação contra produtora de ‘Dark Horse’ por motivação política
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro accused STF Minister Flávio Dino of political motivation in authorizing a Federal Police operation against the producer of the film 'Dark Horse', which investigates the alleged misallocation of congressional amendments. He denied any irregularities in the film's funding and criticized supposed Supreme Court interference in the elections, while beginning his campaign in northern Brazil.

item.title: Conselho de Direitos Humanos cobra revisão ética no STF
item.description: The CNDH asked the STF to review its protocols and internal rules amid a deepening institutional crisis. The body emphasized preserving the functional independence of the justices.

item.title: Dark Horse: Mário Frias chama operação da PF de "cortina de fumaça"
item.description: Mário Frias called the Federal Police's Operation Make Up a “smokescreen,” denied wrongdoing, and pledged to cooperate with the investigation. The PF executed 49 search and seizure warrants, seized the congressman's cellphone, and is examining earmarked funds and financial transactions tied to the producer of the film Dark Horse.

item.title: PF suspeita que ao menos R$ 750 mil de verbas públicas foram desviadas para produtora que fez filme sobre Bolsonaro
item.description: Federal Police investigate suspected diversion of R$750,000 in public funds to finance the producer of 'Dark Horse', a biographical film about Jair Bolsonaro. The operation traces a link between parliamentary amendments from deputy Mário Frias and payments to Go Up Entertainment, the company behind the film.

item.title: Haddad aciona Justiça por espaço “cenográfico” para receber Tarcísio
item.description: Haddad's (PT) campaign filed a legal complaint after a report revealed the São Paulo city hall set up a fake Descomplica 24h unit at the Palácio dos Correios for a visit by Tarcísio (Republicanos) and Mayor Nunes (MDB). The structure was emptied minutes after the politicians left, with no public service provided. The city hall denied wrongdoing, claiming staff left for lunch.

item.title: Edinho atribui à crise no STF momento de Lula nas pesquisas
item.description: Edinho Silva linked the STF crisis to Flávio Bolsonaro's rise in polls, citing an 'antisystem sentiment' that weakens institutions and affects Lula's image. He warned that polarization and loss of trust in democratic institutions harm the overall political climate.

item.title: Ao vivo: Flávio Bolsonaro realiza live em seu canal do YouTube
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), presidential candidate, hosts a live stream on his YouTube channel at 7 PM this Thursday (Sept 10, 2026). The broadcast is part of a weekly series he has been conducting since July 23, resuming the direct communication strategy used by his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Quem são os candidatos a presidente da República nas eleições 2026
item.description: Thirteen candidates have been officially registered for the 2026 presidential election, with Lula (PT) seeking reelection and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) representing the Bolsonaro legacy. Jair Bolsonaro is ineligible due to conviction for attempted coup d'état. The first round takes place on October 4th.

item.title: Credibilidade fiscal do Brasil será moldada por próximas eleições e disposição do Congresso, diz Fitch
item.description: Fitch noted that Brazil's 2027 budget proposal highlights fiscal challenges, with an insufficient pace to stabilize public debt. The country's fiscal credibility will depend on upcoming elections and the stance of the National Congress.

item.title: Flávio ataca Dino, mas rifou a produtora de Dark Horse
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro criticized the Federal Police operation investigating alleged misuse of parliamentary amendments related to Dark Horse, the producer of the film about Jair Bolsonaro. The senator accuses STF minister Flávio Dino of political interference. Producer Karina Gama and Deputy Mario Frias were also targeted by the investigation.

item.title: Caiado: quadro de faringite pode se resolver em 72h ou até uma semana
item.description: Presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) was hospitalized in São Paulo to treat acute pharyngitis, receiving intravenous medication to speed recovery and resume campaign activities. According to his office, the condition may improve within 72 hours or up to a week.

item.title: Flávio: “A terceira facada chegou” após operação da PF
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro labeled the PF operation against the production of the film 'Dark Horse' as another 'stab' against his political group, using the phrase 'the third stab has arrived' in reference to the attack his father suffered.

item.title: Gonet se reúne com Fachin em meio à crise entre ministros do STF
item.description: Prosecutor General Paulo Gonet met with STF President Edson Fachin to discuss the suspension of an investigation into the production of a Federal Police report requested by Minister André Mendonça. The report involved messages between Daniel Vorcaro and Minister Alexandre de Moraes, deepening the internal crisis within the STF. Fachin decided to take the case to the Plenary, with an extraordinary session scheduled for September 15th.

item.title: ‘Dark Horse’ pode fazer “Flávio crescer”, avalia Renan
item.description: Renan Santos, candidate from Missão à Presidência, stated that the Federal Police operation related to the 'Dark Horse' film may have a positive impact on Flávio Bolsonaro, suggesting that the corruption scandal may not negatively affect his electoral support.

item.title: A estratégia de aliados de Lula no Congresso para ressuscitar escândalo Dark Horse
item.description: Lula's allies plan judicial and legislative actions to revive the Dark Horse scandal involving Mário Frias and alleged misuse of parliamentary amendments to fund the producer of a biographical film about Jair Bolsonaro. The strategy aims to damage Flávio Bolsonaro's 2026 presidential candidacy by demonstrating the political use of public funds for electoral purposes.

item.title: Caiado é internado em SP para tratar faringite aguda
item.description: Presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) was hospitalized at Hospital Vila Nova Star in São Paulo to treat acute pharyngitis with intravenous medication. His scheduled campaign event for the morning was canceled, with expectations he will recover quickly to resume his electoral agenda.

item.title: Ex-marqueteiro de Flávio repassou R$ 1 milhão à produtora de “Dark Horse”
item.description: Former campaign manager Marcello Lopes transferred 1 million reais to the producer of 'Dark Horse' movie, allegedly at the request of Mario Frias. The investigation, authorized by federal authorities, scrutinizes suspicious financial transactions linked to the film production and Frias's campaign.

item.title: PF vê coincidência entre emendas de Mario Frias e gastos de Dark Horse
item.description: The Federal Police uncovered a link between parliamentary amendments from lawmaker Mário Frias (PL) and payments from Go Up, the production company behind the biographical film Dark Horse portraying Jair Bolsonaro. The probe reveals R$2 million in amendments funneled through the Conhecer Brasil Institute to companies tied to the film.

item.title: Se o STF poupar Moraes, Lula perde as eleições, indica pesquisa Atlas/Bloomberg
item.description: An Atlas/Bloomberg poll suggests that President Lula's overreliance on the Supreme Court and Justice Minister Alexandre de Moraes could cost him votes, particularly benefiting contender Flávio Bolsonaro. Alleged ties between Moraes and banker Daniel Vorcaro emerge as a pivotal issue, fueling public backlash against the minister. Political analysts warn that shielding Moraes within the Supreme Court might drag Lula’s administration deeper into an irreversible institutional crisis.

item.title: Augusto Cury diz que pode apoiar Flávio no 2º turno se ele 'provar que não tem corrupção' em Dark Horse
item.description: Augusto Cury conditioned potential support for Flávio Bolsonaro in a second round on proof of no corruption in the financing of the film Dark Horse. He rejected supporting Lula and demanded transparency regarding payments linked to the case. Flávio denied irregularities and claimed the funds were merely private sponsorship.

item.title: Lula x Flávio: quem é mais confiável para gerir economia, emprego e impostos, segundo pesquisa Atlas
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro leads Lula in the Atlas/Bloomberg poll on trustworthiness to manage the economy, employment, and taxes, leading in 12 of the 13 tested areas. The PL outperforms the PT on issues such as inflation, jobs, taxation, and infrastructure, while Lula only leads on environmental protection. Flávio's advantage is reflected in the second-round scenario, marked by a technical tie, although Lula is ahead in the first round.

item.title: AtlasIntel: avaliação de Lula oscila para cima, mas o saldo ainda é negativo
item.description: AtlasIntel research shows a slight increase in positive assessments of the Lula government in September, with 38.3% rating it good or excellent, but negative opinions remain majority (50.8%). Personal approval of Lula rose to 43.7%, while disapproval reached 53.8%, maintaining a net negative perception of the president.

item.title: Malafaia questiona estratégia de Flávio sobre ‘Dark Horse’
item.description: Pastor Silas Malafaia criticized Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) over his strategy regarding the funding of the film 'Dark Horse', which chronicles Jair Bolsonaro's trajectory. While stating that Flávio is not responsible for the money management, Malafaia deemed his responses inappropriate. The issue raises concerns about transparency and public spending.

item.title: Moraes autoriza visitas permanentes de 5 familiares a Bolsonaro
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes authorized permanent visits from five relatives to former President Jair Bolsonaro, currently under house arrest in Brasília. The ruling allows meetings on Wednesdays and Saturdays, during morning and afternoon periods, including sons Carlos and Jair Renan Bolsonaro. The measure also frees Michelle Bolsonaro to campaign for the Senate by the PL in the Federal District.

item.title: PF suspeita que produtora de ‘Dark Horse’ embolsou R$ 750 mil de verbas públicas
item.description: The Federal Police investigate the suspected embezzlement of R$750,000 in public funds from parliamentary amendments, allegedly funneled to the producer of the biopic Dark Horse, which depicts Jair Bolsonaro. The investigation, leading to Operation Make Up, reveals links between Go Up Entertainment and NTT Brasil, along with R$83 million in transactions through the Instituto Conhecer Brasil, whose amendments were approved by federal deputy Mário Frias (PL-SP). Minister Flávio Dino ordered the seizure of Frias's passport and barred him from contacting other suspects.

item.title: O desempenho de Augusto Cury na nova pesquisa AtlasIntel
item.description: Augusto Cury (Avante) ranks third in the 2026 presidential race with 6.6% of voting intentions, behind Lula (43%) and Flávio Bolsonaro (37.4%). In a hypothetical second round against Lula, Cury reaches 41.1% compared to Lula's 43.8%, remaining within the margin of error. The survey was conducted between September 4 and 9 with 5,000 voters and registered with the TSE.

item.title: Supremo evoca rotina de desfaçatez
item.description: Retired ministers of the STF request President Edson Fachin to issue a statement regarding suspicions involving the Supreme Court, evoking a past era of bluntness in the court. The signed letter reflects concern over the institution's image. The request seeks transparency amid questions about ministerial conduct.

item.title: Lula tem 53,8% de desaprovação na AltasIntel
item.description: AtlasIntel poll released April 10 shows President Lula's (PT) disapproval reached 53.8%, near his negative record of 54% set in March and May 2023. His approval fell from 45% in August to 43.7%.

item.title: Flávio tem 46,4% e Lula, 46,2% no 2º turno, diz AtlasIntel
item.description: The AtlasIntel/Bloomberg survey released on September 10, 2026 shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) at 46.4% and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) at 46.2% in a hypothetical runoff, within the 1-point margin of error. The poll surveyed 5,000 voters from September 4 to 9, with a 95% confidence level and a cost of R$75,000.

item.title: O preço da opacidade do STF chegou à conta
item.description: The STF is facing an unprecedented institutional crisis after the presidency suspended decisions by André Mendonça and Flávio Dino, distanced Alexandre de Moraes from the fake news investigation, and called an extraordinary session to judge conversations between Moraes and Daniel Vorcaro. The root cause lies in the lack of transparency within the Court, generating instability and doubts about judicial independence. This weakened institutional scenario may negatively affect governability and voter confidence ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Lula x Flávio: pesquisa AtlasIntel aponta de quem os brasileiros têm mais medo
item.description: The AtlasIntel poll shows 45.9% of voters fear Flávio Bolsonaro's election, against 45.0% who fear Lula's reelection, though both are statistically tied. Lula leads rejection with 52.5%, followed by Flávio at 49.6%.

item.title: Ronaldo Caiado é internado com faringite aguda em São Paulo
item.description: Presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) was hospitalized on Thursday morning at Vila Nova Star Hospital in São Paulo due to acute pharyngitis. He is receiving intravenous medication under the supervision of Dr. Ludhmila Abrahão Hajjar to speed up recovery and return to his campaign schedule soon. Today's events, including a visit to CICOM in Vinhedo and a debate in the capital, were canceled.

item.title: Pesquisa Atlas: Lula é desaprovado por 53,8% dos brasileiros e aprovado por 43,7%
item.description: Atlas/Bloomberg poll shows 53.8% of Brazilians disapprove of Lula's government, up from 52.9% in the previous survey, while 43.7% approve. The administration is rated as bad or terrible by 50.8%, with 38.3% seeing it as excellent or good. The study surveyed 5,000 people digitally recruited and registered with the TSE.

item.title: ‘Trade Flávio’ leva aposta no Brasil a recorde em Wall Street
item.description: Brazilian asset appreciation hit a record on Wall Street, with the EWZ surpassing $20 billion in call options, coinciding with Flávio Bolsonaro's advance over Lula on Polymarket. Recent surveys show a technical tie between the two candidates, but the market reacts with great enthusiasm to the possibility of a conservative victory.

item.title: Empresária de “Dark Horse” comprou BYD com dinheiro vivo
item.description: Entrepreneur Karina Ferreira da Gama, linked to the film 'Dark Horse', bought a BYD car paying R$102,190.00 entirely in cash, per a Federal Police decision investigating the film's funding. The Make Up operation, authorized by Minister Flávio Dino, probes potential misuse of public funds and political ties, including Senator Flávio Bolsonaro. The case is connected to the Banco Master investigation and the 2026 election race.

item.title: Presidente do Novo manda vereadores proporem moção de repúdio contra Moraes nas câmaras municipais
item.description: The leader of the Novo party, Eduardo Ribeiro, instructed municipal councilors to propose motions of rejection against Minister Alexandre de Moraes, aiming to mobilize society and pressure senators toward an impeachment process. The party also raises concerns over contracts involving Moraes' family and his role in the fake news investigation. The initiative seeks to build political pressure before the Supreme Court's decision on Moraes.

item.title: Pesquisa AtlasIntel: Flávio e Zema superam Lula em décimos no segundo turno, e Caiado empata
item.description: AtlasIntel poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro and Romeu Zema surpassing Lula in hypothetical runoffs, while Caiado ties with the PT candidate. Despite slight leads, all races remain within the margin of error. Lula only leads against Renan Santos and Augusto Cury.

item.title: AtlasIntel mostra empate técnico entre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro no 2º turno
item.description: A survey by AtlasIntel released on September 10, 2026, shows a technical tie between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in the second round of the presidential race. Senator Flávio Bolsonaro leads slightly with 46.4% of voting intentions, against 46.2% for the president. The poll, conducted between September 4 and 9 with 5,000 online interviews, has a margin of error of one percentage point.

item.title: ‘Trump que se meta com o país dele’, diz Lula durante ato político no Piauí
item.description: During an event in Teresina, Lula stated that he will not accept foreign interference in Brazilian elections, directly criticizing Donald Trump and reinforcing the need for Brazil to decide its own fate without relying on external powers.

item.title: Defensores da democracia se tornaram uma ameaça, diz The Economist sobre STF
item.description: The Economist published an article on October 10, 2026 questioning the role of STF members previously seen as democracy defenders after Jair Bolsonaro's conviction, suggesting they now pose a threat to Brazilian democracy itself.

item.title: Ronaldo Caiado é internado em hospital de SP para tratar faringite aguda
item.description: Presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) was hospitalized at Vila Nova Star Hospital in São Paulo to treat acute pharyngitis with intravenous medication. The hospitalization aims to speed up recovery and resume campaign activities, but scheduled events for Thursday were canceled.
